rules.message: Declared journal TUI version differs from the selected target (25.2). Review whether the difference is intentional.
rules.explanation: The journal declares a different TUI version than the selected target. Compatibility differences can be intentional; the linter only asks you to review.
The TUI version declaration is normally placed at the top of a journal so it applies to all recorded commands.

rules.message: Windows-style absolute path in a journal intended for Linux/HPC execution.
rules.explanation: This journal is expected to run on a remote Linux platform, but it references a Windows drive path that will not resolve there.
